name: Dialog
summary: Blocks the page until a question is answered or a short task is done: a title, a description, a body and the answers. Not for something people can ignore (use a notification), for a short confirmation by its button (use a popover) or for a side task while the page stays usable (use a side sheet). Most deletes need no dialog: do them with an undo in an auto-dismissing notification (owner rule).
a11y: The native `dialog` opened with `showModal()`: the page behind is inert, so focus stays inside and Tab cycles through the dialog. Named by its title, described by its description; `role="alertdialog"` when `alert`. Focus starts on the first field or control in the body (the title when there's none), on the first action in an alert dialog, and returns to whatever opened it on close. The close button is named "Close", with a minimum 44 CSS px target in both axes even under root font scaling; its small icon is unchanged. The body is a scroll region with its padding inside, so its scrollbar sits at the dialog's edge and focus rings are never clipped; the title and the actions stay in place. Opening fades and grows a little and closing fades faster (Q65 C17); with reduced motion it only fades. With state, a form becomes its result in the same box (C1, Morph).

keys.action: move through the dialog's controls only

props.name: open
props.description: Shown while true. The parent owns it: set it false in `onClose`.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Escape, the close button or a press outside asked to close (never called for an alert dialog's Escape or outside press).

props.name: title
props.description: What the dialog is about, as a question or a short name: its accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title: what's being asked. Its accessible description.

props.name: children
props.description: The body: a short form, a list, longer reading. Scrolls inside the dialog when it doesn't fit.

props.name: actions
props.description: The answers, as Buttons: the safest first, the main action last (it sits at the end).

props.name: size
props.description: Width: `s` 24 rem (a question), `m` 32 rem (default; a short form), `l` 48 rem (a table or longer reading). Every size fills a narrow window.

props.name: alert
props.description: An alert dialog: for answers that can't be undone. It must be answered with one of the actions: no close button, Escape and a press outside do nothing, and focus starts on the first (safest) action.

props.name: state
props.description: Names what the dialog is showing, e.g. `form`, `done`, `failed` (Q65 C1). A new value morphs the title, body and answers in the same box: the old ones fade out, the new ones fade in and the box eases to its new height; focus moves to the new title. Change it only when the new state is ready (keep the form's pending button until then).
